correctness.rationale: From explicit Hamming-neighbor rule on 16 cube vertices, independently enumerated all C(16,7)=11440 and C(16,8)=12870 candidate blue sets with synchronous closure; none of size 7 succeeds and exactly 2360 size-8 sets succeed. Built every one-element-exchange edge (22848), verified 384 affine cube automorphisms give 11 state orbits, then ran BFS from every orbit representative. Exact degree counts {14:384,18:384,19:384,20:432,22:480,23:192,24:104}, distance P coefficients [2360,45696,355776,1274880,2110368,1361280,371184,45696,2360], all eccentricities 8, Wiener index 11197808, Johnson excess {0:5458192,1:105600,2:5808}. Proved orbit BFS exhaustive because each automorphism preserves forcing and exchanges; this is a complete finite certificate, not a sample.
